topics.topic: How `draft-write` EffectAttempt authority is bound and reused (including across re-activations and resend after `not_applied`)
questions: If the same flow version has been activated more than once, which exact FlowActivation does a draft-write EffectAttempt refer to, and where is that reference pinned for the run?
If a `draft-write` attempt is resolved `not_applied`, what authority must a resend use?

quotes:
- `authority`: the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send
  the flow activation of the run's version (State 2, A10);

Sending again after `not_applied` is a new attempt
under a fresh approval, never under a standing approval (K-08).
judgement.why: One passage assigns `draft-write` sends to flow-activation authority, while another requires resend after `not_applied` to use a fresh approval.

topics.topic: When a proven read-only flow version becomes active (auto at prove/compose vs only via explicit activate)
questions: For a proven read-only flow version, is a FlowActivation created automatically at compose/prove time, or only when an activate action is called?
When exactly is a proven read-only flow activated: automatically at successful proof, only when an activate action is called, or both?

quotes:
A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven; any other
flow only by the owner.
The kernel, after proof and, for effectful versions, the owner.
judgement.why: These passages state that activation of a proven read-only version is automatic after proof, not dependent on an explicit owner activation.

topics.topic: Disclosure class for authored expected outputs in zero-input trial cases
questions: For a trial case of a contract version with no inputs, what disclosure class is assigned to authored expected outputs?

topics.topic: What to do on repeated activation of an already-active flow version (new FlowActivation record vs reuse existing)
questions: If activation is requested (or auto-triggered) for a flow version that is already active, does the kernel append a new FlowActivation record or return the existing active one without writing?

topics.topic: Whether SpooledFile byte reads are a State-0/State-1 product action and who is authorized
questions: Is reading spooled file bytes a State-0/State-1 product action, and if yes, who is allowed to do it?

topics.topic: Whether flow inspection returns historical stored ProofResult or a newly recomputed current result
questions: When reading/inspecting a flow version later, should the kernel return the historical proof result observed at composition time, or a newly recomputed current result (which may differ after other facts change)?
